name: link
purpose: Helps users move between views or sections. Migrated from the existing implementation at `packages/webkit/src/components/navigation/link/`. Design source: [Webkit — Link](https://www.figma.com/design/t97pXRs7xME3SJDs5iZ5RF/Webkit?node-id=3548-578) (`Size` × `State` variants; hover/active handled in CSS).
useWhen: A standalone navigation link: a domain, a repository, a docs page, "View all".
An in-console navigation action ("Add custom domain") with `showIcon` set to false.
avoidWhen: A link inside a sentence → use a plain anchor with the text-link class.
An action that changes something instead of navigating → use `button`.
A compact marketing CTA with a brand-colored icon inside a card → use `mini-button`.
related: mini-button` — same anatomy in default text color with a brand-colored icon; `large` and `medium` only.
button` — set `href` when a link must look like a button.
breadcrumb` — a trail of links for hierarchical location.
bestPractices: Always set `href` and a `label` that names the destination; the defaults (`'#'`, `'Learn more'`) are placeholders.
Keep the default `pi pi-external-link` icon for off-site targets with `target="_blank"` (`rel="noopener noreferrer"` is added for you); turn `showIcon` off for in-app destinations.
Match `size` to the controls around it; heights follow `button` (40 / 32 / 28 px).
disabled` drops it from the tab order and suppresses `click`; hide a link that can never be followed instead.

props.name: label
props.doc: Visible label rendered inside the link. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Learn more`).

props.name: size
props.doc: Size token; affects height and typography (large 40px, medium 32px, small 28px), matching Button.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables interaction and applies disabled tokens.

props.name: showIcon
props.doc: When true, renders the trailing icon.

props.name: icon
props.doc: PrimeIcons class for the trailing icon.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Link from '@aziontech/webkit/link'
</script>

<template>
  <Link
    label="Learn more"
    size="large"
    href="#"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Sizes
Disabled
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Link from '@aziontech/webkit/link'
</script>

<template>
  <Link
    label="Learn more"
    disabled
  />
</template>
